label: Developer preview
new: A skippable, saved first-day tutorial guides opening, staff, Decorate and a real first order through payment. Resume or replay it from Help.
Real outside visitors queue before entering, with first-in-first-out admission, limited space and a waiting timeout.
Buy a fixed four-bay parking lot for 2,000 coins in Decorate. The same customers park, queue, dine, return to their cars and drive away; visits survive reloading.
Roadside greenery, passing traffic and bus-stop visitors, with connected curved pavement and kerbs.
Choose 60 or 120 FPS in Settings. The default is 60; higher frame rates can use more battery and produce more heat.
Copy a private, session-only diagnostic Log from Settings to help report save problems.
Separate platform builds support CrazyGames saves and a Firebase Google-account cloud-save preview. Ordinary Web progress stays separate.
Preview limits: live account and cross-device saves, final visuals and physical-device performance still need acceptance. This is not a formal release or a CrazyGames publication.
fixed: Welcome stays animated, with Little Leaf branding shown until the game is ready.
Play and Decorate share the camera range and preserve your view. Fit frames your owned cafe in Play and clears the shop in Decorate.
Decorate hides outside people. Unowned parking stays hidden; occupied or reserved parking cannot be sold.
Eligible purchases returned in the same Decorate session receive a full refund, including furniture, walls, doors, windows and parking. Later resale uses the original paid cost.
Browse full and half Wall styles in the Build tray; replace existing walls and place doors and windows with clearer controls and softer selection outlines.
Correct tree depth, pan-handle direction and layering, the single stove control, the connected drink spout and rotated cup-accessory depth.
Improve cleaner approach positions, obstacle clearance and rear-facing hand/tool layering, while reusing unchanged cleaning calculations.
Round coin-icon edges correctly at smaller sizes, improve compact controls and frame-rate spacing, and keep Help & Updates in Settings.
Recover safely from a closing browser save connection. CrazyGames save acknowledgements, pending changes and Inbox history follow confirmed progress.
Reduce repeated hidden-character, background and UI work. Web play suspends in the background and resumes without simulating the missed time.
